t: Russian Foreign Minister Arrives in Bahrain
d: Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov has arrived in Bahrain, where on Sunday he will take part in the ninth round of the strategic dialogue between Russia and the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC), a Sputnik correspondent has reported.

t: Ukraine Requested Access to Starshield for Strikes Deep Inside Russia - Rubio
d: Ukraine requested access to the Starshield communications system to carry out strikes deep inside Russia, but it does not have such access now, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said.

t: Two People Killed in Arab Coalition's AH-6i Military Helicopter Crash - Spokesman
d: The Saudi-led Arab coalition fighting the Houthis has announced the crash of an AH-6i light attack helicopter in the Saudi province of Najran, which borders Yemen, the coalition's spokesman, Maj. Gen. Turki al-Maliki, said.

t: At Least 7 Killed, Dozens Injured in Explosion, Fire at Canadian Military Base - Reports
d: At least seven people have been killed and dozens injured as a result of an explosion and subsequent fire at the Canadian Wainwright military base, the Global News channel reported, citing several military sources.

t: Ukraine to Pay Over $160Bln in Public Debt by 2037
d: Ukraine is set to pay $160.348 billion toward the servicing and repayment of its public debt over the next 10 years, according to a payment schedule from the Ukrainian Finance Ministry analyzed by Sputnik.

t: Countries Increasingly Often Regret Shunning Russian Energy Resources - Deputy PM
d: An increasing number of politicians and countries around the world are expressing regret over their decision to turn away from Russian energy resources, Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak said.

t: Russian Army Delivers Group Strike on Ukraine's Logistics, Ports Overnight
d: The Russian Armed Forces delivered a group strike on logistics centers and ports in Ukraine overnight, the Russian Defense Ministry said on Sunday.

t: Russia’s Rassvet Satellite Network Flagged as ‘Danger No. 1’ By Ukraine
d: Zelensky’s tech advisor sounds alarm about Russia’s answer to Starlink - Rassvet satellite constellation.

t: Russian Scientists Develop Cortisol-Reducing Food to Boost Classic Antidepressants
d: The product designed by the Moscow-based Gorbatov Federal Research Center for Food Systems team is vegetable-and-fruit puree with tryptophan and antioxidants that may help prevent depression.

t: Ukraine Caused Nearly $13 Billion in Damage to Russian Regions - Investigators
d: The Russian Investigative Committee has estimated the damage inflicted by Ukraine on Donbass and the border and rear regions of Russia at almost $13 billion, Investigative Committee Chairman Alexander Bastrykin told Sputnik on Sunday.

t: US Should Abandon Hegemony, Cooperate With Other Countries – Expert
d: The United States should renounce claims to global dominance and start cooperating with other countries, because the time of its hegemony has ended, a former vice president of the Washington-based Eurasia Center, Earl Rasmussen, told RIA…

t: Prolonged Strait of Hormuz Crisis Could Push Oil Prices Higher - Russian Deputy PM
d: If the situation in the Strait of Hormuz persists, it will drive oil prices even higher, Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak said on Saturday.

t: Lavrov Holds Talks With Saudi Counterpart on Sidelines of Russia–GCC Dialogue in Manama
d: Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov held talks with Saudi Foreign Minister Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud in Manama, the Bahraini capital, on the sidelines of the ninth round of the Russia–Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) strategic dialogue…

t: Lavrov Takes Part in 9th Round of Russia-Gulf Cooperation Council Dialogue
d: The 9th round of the Russia-Gulf Cooperation Council Strategic Dialogue is taking place in Manama, Bahrain.

t: Russia Supports Arab Efforts to Prevent Full-Scale War in Region - Lavrov
d: Russia supports the peacekeeping efforts of Arab countries aimed at preventing the return of a full-scale war to the Middle East region, Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov said on Sunday.

t: Russia Shoots Down Seven Ukrainian Flamingo Cruise Missiles
d: Ukraine lost up to 350 soldiers in combat against Russia's Tsentr battlegroup over the past day, in addition to losses in manpower and equipment on other fronts, the Russian Defense Ministry said on Sunday.

t: Iran’s New Defense Chief Warns US Will Pay Heavily for Another Attack
d: The US will not dare to attack Iran, otherwise it will suffer huge damage, the new defense minister of Iran, Mehrdad Akhlaghi, said on Sunday.

t: Russia, Saudi Arabia Committed to Effective Cooperation Within OPEC+ - Foreign Ministry
d: Russia and Saudi Arabia are committed to effective cooperation within the OPEC+ format, the Russian Foreign Ministry said on Sunday.

t: Russia's Trade With Gulf States Up by 45% - Lavrov
d: Russia's total trade with the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) member states showed significant growth last year, increasing by 45%, Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov said on Sunday.

t: France’s Toll of Fury: 1,800 Arrests, 1,500 Businesses Hit, 500+ Police Injured, Millions in Damage
d: France is counting the cost of one of its strongest days of unrest in years after protests against the cost of living spiraled into nationwide rioting.

t: Gulf Countries Highly Value Russia's Calls for De-Escalation in Region - Bahraini Ministry
d: The countries of the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) highly value Russia's calls for de-escalation in the Middle East, Bahraini Foreign Minister Abdullatif bin Rashid Al Zayani said on Sunday.

t: Russian Diesel Supplies Beneficial to US Consumers - US Energy Secretary
d: Diesel fuel supplies from Russia could benefit consumers in the United States, US Energy Secretary Chris Wright said on Sunday.

t: Iran to Open Strait of Hormuz on 6th Day If US Fulfills Conditions - Foreign Ministry
d: If the US fulfills Iran's conditions, the Strait of Hormuz will be opened on the sixth day, and on the seventh day negotiations will begin, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said on Sunday.

t: Russia, Kuwait Advocate De-Escalation in Persian Gulf - Foreign Ministry
d: Russia and Kuwait consider it necessary to find ways to de-escalate situation in the Persian Gulf region, the Russian Foreign Ministry said on Sunday.

t: Zelensky Does Not Want to Advance on Agreements Out of Fear for His Regime - Lavrov
d: Volodymyr Zelensky does not want to even advance on the subject of agreements, since he understands that any agreement would mean the end of his regime, Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov said on Friday.

t: GCC, Russia Working on New Economic, Investment Projects - Secretary-General
d: The Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) and Russia are working on a number of new economic and investment proposals aimed at further expanding cooperation, GCC Secretary-General Jasem Al-Budaiwi said on Sunday.

t: Lavrov, Araghchi to Discuss Trade, Economic, Investment Cooperation
d: Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi will discuss trade, economic, and investment cooperation during talks in Tehran, the Russian Foreign Ministry said on Sunday.

t: Turkiye Expects to Receive Share of Diesel Fuel Under US-Russia Deal - Minister
d: Turkiye expects to receive a portion of the diesel fuel under the US-Russia agreement, Turkish Energy Minister Alparslan Bayraktar said on Sunday.

t: Macron Says Demanded Government Take Measures to Prevent Street Unrest
d: French President Emmanuel Macron said on Sunday he demanded that the government take measures to prevent a repeat of the street unrest.
